integrity: The exact Fourier frequency cancellation is independently reproducible from the displayed spectral labels. Kronecker density and convex relative-interior transfer establish infinite-time-tail existence; finite numerical checks corroborate but do not prove it.
scientific_limitations: The result is an existence theorem only for ordinary adjacency quantum walks on C10, with at most six distinct common sample times above each prescribed cutoff. It gives no closed-form physical observation times or proof of support-size optimality. Originality is best-of-knowledge, not exhaustive certification.
title: Exact randomized-time uniform quantum mixing on the ten-cycle
